Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
If there is a Trap in play, then can you play Boxed In to continue?

Boxed In
Do not replace until after combat.Press.

Trap
Only usable before range is determined during the first round of combat.Put this card in play with 3 counters. Each time a card is played this combat, reset the number of counters on this card to 3. During the press step of each round this combat, this Trap automatically burns 1 counter from itself to provide 1 press to continue combat (either combatant can press to end combat). Burn this card at the end of combat.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
The trap provides a mandatory press to continue that you have to handle first. You cannot use a press to continue if there's already a press to continue.

Prince of Paris, France

For me this doesn't allow one of them to trigger in press step but it doesn't restrict a possibility to play them both before range is determined. Can you clarify this.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Tadori wrote:
> For me this doesn't allow one of them to trigger in press step but it doesn't restrict a possibility to play them both before range is determined. Can you clarify this.
>
You can't play Boxed In prior to range being determined. It's a press, so you play it in the press step. (Except in this situation, you can't.)

A variety of other cards will give you an optional press e.g. playing Flash for a maneuver, with an optional press. You can play for the maneuver during set range. During the press step, you will have an optional maneuver. You could use it to cancel the press from Trap, but you couldn't use it to press to continue while the press from Trap is uncancelled. You couldn't play Flash just for a press (at inferior) to continue while the Trap press is uncancelled, such as if you just wanted to cycle the card out of your hand but did want combat to go to a second round.

If you have another mandatory press to continue (e.g. Talbot's Chainsaw), one of the presses is used - Trap, or Talbot's - and the other would be ignored for the time-being.
